caseNameFull: Lewis et vir, Individually, as Parents, as Next Friends, and as Administrators of the Estate of Lewis v. Brunswick Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Cer-tiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, December 29, 1997. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., *979Wednesday, January 28,1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, February 18,1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
